key_rule: only generated keys/backup.key allowed; outside data; 0600; raw bytes never enter protocol/receipts
mutation_rules: Exact per-phase data/key deltas plus exactly the two declared instrumentation outputs. No other add/modify/delete/mode changes. Reader data/key delta is empty. Directory ctime/atime/mtime are not a no-change claim; designated no-op file inode/mtime_ns/ciphertext hash must match exactly.
immutable_input_rule: this exact repository fixture path outside every mutable root; hash before and after every trial; no blanket scanner exception
both_wrong_rule: In both trials actually write integer 2 instead of 1 at record.one in cases 3 and 9, preserving the case 9 no-op invariant. Defer only resulting typed JSON/serialized-byte semantic mismatches until two complete 19-phase corpora; source, privacy, schema, ledger, retained effects, no-op identity, wait and cleanup checks stay immediate.

order: set this Python child umask to 0022
import site and run site.main() to restore the selected environment
load pinned shared observer and provider modules
bootstrap.scope: No Rust parent process umask or environment mutation; interpreter bootstrap precedes the os call, but application/site imports follow it.
bootstrap.shared_observer_rule: -S prevents sitecustomize/provider imports before child umask. After child-only umask, site.main loads the pinned shared observer from an exact PYTHONPATH. Observer input is this immutable fixture (fault none), not a copied plaintext canary control file. Selected negative phase/mode is separate nonsecret invocation metadata.

input_location_rule: Repository docs/plans/2026-11-05-rust-data-fixture-v1.json is outside every mutable owned root and immutable by SHA-256 before/after each trial. Shared observer reads this exact no-fault control file; per-negative selection is separate nonsecret phase metadata. No duplicate plaintext canary control file or blanket scanner exception.

argument_digest_rule: At the actual original API entry, bind the arguments received using that original signature and apply defaults. Encode the ACTUAL bound path as an owned-relative path Node and all actual other values as typed Nodes. Hash UTF-8 JSON of those observed argument-name to Node bindings with sorted object keys, ensure_ascii true, compact comma/colon separators and allow_nan false. Compare with independent expected_bound_arguments; fixture declarations never stand in for observed arguments.
target_binding_rule: Every primary and auxiliary call reports target from the actual bound path parameter. Canonicalize only the trusted supplied owned root once. Before any target resolve/normalization, require the current os.fspath argument to equal owned-root plus the exact registered relative target; reject outside, .., alias spellings and symlink components/leaf. Validate the immutable fixture relative spelling before constructing Path. A Path object may already have discarded redundant separators before entry; do not claim to observe its earlier construction history. Never use actual target.resolve to turn an alias into an accepted target.
projection_rule: Select by exact case/role/ledger purpose: reader primary 2/8 str-sha256; reader serialized-bytes calls 3/4/5/6/7/9 str-sha256; reader primary 10 recursive typed literal str; all other primary returns recursive typed literal. Never guess from content.
validation_precedence: actual lifecycle/owner outcome: reject process failure, missing wait or cleanup failure
bounded streams/protocol schema and source/actual API function/count/target binding
raw canary checks before any retained acceptance/hash; plaintext control must already have actual declared completed writer evidence
designated no-op raw ciphertext/inode/mtime identity: no_op_identity_mismatch before generic semantic/delta rejection
typed argument/return/serialized semantics with only registered cases 3/9 deferrals
frozen actual reference and two-complete-corpus evidence
